title: Arbitration and Conciliation Act s. 29 — Statutory provision (ACA s. 29)

content.overview: Section 29 provides that, unless the parties agree otherwise, decisions of a multi-member arbitral tribunal are made by a majority of all its members. Questions of procedure may be decided by the presiding arbitrator where the parties or all members have authorised that course.

content.study:
Section 29 — Decision making by panel of arbitrators

Section 29 provides that, unless the parties agree otherwise, decisions of a multi-member arbitral tribunal are made by a majority of all its members. Questions of procedure may be decided by the presiding arbitrator where the parties or all members have authorised that course.

The provision must be applied by identifying its operative conditions, the procedural stage and its connected sections. Statutory exceptions and party agreements must be kept distinct from the default rule.
